findings.motion: Reported statement of support for the federal Save America Act (news report by Michelle Vecerina, republished on the campaign site; reporter's paraphrase, not a direct quote). Passage as published: "On domestic policy and governance, Green threw his full support behind the federal Save America Act, which would require proof of citizenship and identification to vote in federal elections. Pointing to his personal experience assisting with the 2000 Florida presidential recount, Green emphasized that safeguarding the integrity of the electoral system remains a paramount priority for defending the republic."
findings.note: A news report, posted on his own campaign site, says he fully supports the Save America Act (proof of citizenship and identification to vote in federal elections) and calls election integrity a priority, citing his help with the 2000 Florida recount. These are the reporter's words, not his; no direct quote on the subject was found.
